  <div><strong>Status:</strong> <span id="w-status" style="color:#28a745;font-weight:bold;">Operational</span></div>
  <div><strong>Active Links:</strong> <span id="w-links">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Stations Heard via RF (last 12 hours):</strong> <span id="w-rf">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Stations Heard via AXIP (last 12 hours):</strong> <span id="w-axip">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Last Packet:</strong> <span id="w-last">...</span></div>
</div>

## Live MHeard

<div style="margin:10px 0;">
  <button id="btn-rf" style="padding:6px 10px;background:#2e7d32;color:white;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;">
    RF (Port 1)
  </button>

  <button id="btn-axip" style="padding:6px 10px;background:#1565c0;color:white;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;">
    AXIP (Port 3)
  </button>
</div>

<div id="mheard-container"><p>Loading...</p></div>

<hr>

## Network Routing Nodes

<input id="node-search" placeholder="Search nodes..." style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:10px;">

<div id="nodes-container" style="max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid #eee;padding:10px;background:#fafafa;">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

<script>
let allNodes = [];
let mheardMode = "ALL";

function parseTime(st) {
  let t = st.lastHeard;
  if (t && !t.endsWith("Z") && !t.includes("+")) t += "Z";
  return Date.parse(t);
}

function formatUTC(ts) {
  return new Date(ts)
    .toISOString()
    .substring(0, 19)
    .replace("T", " ") + " UTC";
}

async function fetchDashboardData() {
  const base = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";

  const [linksRes, mheardRes, nodesRes] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(base + "/links"),
    fetch(base + "/mheard"),
    fetch(base + "/nodes")
  ]);

  if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok || !nodesRes.ok)
    throw new Error("API failure");

  const links = (await linksRes.json()).links || [];
  const rawMheard = (await mheardRes.json()).mheard || [];
  allNodes = (await nodesRes.json()).nodes || [];

  const twelveHoursAgo = Date.now() - (12 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const mheard = rawMheard
    .map(st => ({ ...st, ts: parseTime(st) }))
    .filter(st => !isNaN(st.ts) && st.ts >= twelveHoursAgo)
    .sort((a,b) => b.ts - a.ts);

  // ---------------- ACTIVITY FEED ----------------
  document.getElementById("activity-feed-container").innerHTML =
    mheard.map(st =>
      `<div style="margin-bottom:4px;">
        🕒 ${formatUTC(st.ts)}
        <b>${st.callSign}</b>
        <span style="color:#666;">→ Port ${st.port}</span>
      </div>`
    ).join("") || "<p>No recent activity</p>";

  // ---------------- LINKS (RESTORED STYLING) ----------------
  document.getElementById("links-container").innerHTML =
    links.length === 0
      ? "<p>No active links</p>"
      : `<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:10px;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #ccc;text-align:left;">
              <th style="padding:8px;">Remote Node</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Port</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Type</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Status</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${links.map(l => {
              const state = (l.state || "ACTIVE").toUpperCase();
              const isUp =
                state === "ACTIVE" ||
                state === "ESTABLISHED" ||
                state === "CONNECTED";

              const bg = isUp ? "#d4edda" : "#f8d7da";
              const tc = isUp ? "#155724" : "#721c24";

              return `
                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
                  <td style="padding:8px;font-weight:bold;color:#2c3e50;">${l.farCall}</td>
                  <td style="padding:8px;">Port ${l.port}</td>
                  <td style="padding:8px;color:#666;">${l.linkType || "AXUDP"}</td>
                  <td style="padding:8px;">
                    <span style="background:${bg};color:${tc};padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.85em;font-weight:bold;">
                      ${state}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              `;
            }).join("")}
          </tbody>
        </table>`;

  // ---------------- MHEARD ----------------
  const filtered = mheard.filter(st => {
    if (mheardMode === "RF") return Number(st.port) === 1;
    if (mheardMode === "AXIP") return Number(st.port) === 3;
    return true;
  });

  document.getElementById("mheard-container").innerHTML =
    filtered.length === 0
      ? "<p>No stations</p>"
      : `<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:10px;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #ccc;text-align:left;">
              <th style="padding:8px;">Call</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Port</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Packets</th>
              <th style="padding:8px;">Last Heard</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${filtered.map(st => `
              <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">
                <td style="padding:8px;font-weight:bold;color:${Number(st.port) === 1 ? "#2e7d32" : "#1565c0"};">
                  ${st.callSign}
                </td>
                <td style="padding:8px;">${st.port}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px;">${Number(st.packets || 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px;color:#555;">${formatUTC(st.ts)}</td>
              </tr>
            `).join("")}
          </tbody>
        </table>`;

  // ---------------- METRICS ----------------
  let rf = 0, axip = 0;
  let latest = 0, latestCall = "";

  mheard.forEach(st => {
    if (st.ts > latest) {
      latest = st.ts;
      latestCall = st.callSign;
    }

    if (st.ts >= Date.now() - 12*60*60*1000) {
      if (Number(st.port) === 1) rf++;
      if (Number(st.port) === 3) axip++;
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = links.length;
  document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = rf;
  document.getElementById("w-axip").innerText = axip;

  if (latest) {
    const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - latest) / 60000);

    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText =
      diff < 1 ? `${latestCall} - Just now` :
      diff < 60 ? `${latestCall} - ${diff} mins ago` :
      `${latestCall} - ${Math.floor(diff/60)} hrs ago`;
  } else {
    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText = "No data";
  }

  document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Operational";

  renderNodes(allNodes);
}

// ---------------- NODES ----------------
function renderNodes(list) {
  const el = document.getElementById("nodes-container");

  el.innerHTML = list.map(n => `
    <div style="background:white;border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;border-radius:4px;">
      <b>${n.Call}</b> ${n.Alias ? ":" + n.Alias : ""}
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:#666;">Routes: ${n.Routes?.length || 0}</div>
    </div>
  `).join("");
}

// ---------------- EVENTS ----------------
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchDashboardData();
  setInterval(fetchDashboardData, 60000);

  document.getElementById("btn-rf").onclick = () => {
    mheardMode = "RF";
    fetchDashboardData();
  };

  document.getElementById("btn-axip").onclick = () => {
    mheardMode = "AXIP";
    fetchDashboardData();
  };

  document.getElementById("node-search").addEventListener("input", e => {
    const t = (e.target.value || "").toUpperCase();

    renderNodes(allNodes.filter(n =>
      (n.Call || "").toUpperCase().includes(t) ||
      (n.Alias || "").toUpperCase().includes(t)
    ));
  });
});
</script>
